text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing
with Rice Shower on a day off...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Our outing today was so much fun, Onii-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Our outing today was so much fun, Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!! If it isn't Rice!
Just in the nick of time!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eek... Hishi Ama-san!?
W-What is it...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oops, sorry, sorry. Did I scare you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I just wanted a little help with the cooking!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Cooking, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, today's the day I treat
the dorm girls to my home cooking, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I bought plenty of ingredients, but we're short on hands here!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm...
Rice will just be a bother if she tries...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: A bother? Oh, are ya talkin' about the other day?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The kitchen got covered in pure white, sure, but wasn't that
just because the flour bag was already torn to begin with?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Stuff like that happens all the time!
In fact, it was hilarious, so don't even worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, make those croquettes again!
Those were seriously delicious!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to eat that again, too. What do you say?
Care to give me a hand, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-But... I really don't think
Rice is the right one for this...
choice_data_list: Just think of it as helping someone out.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Do you want to eat Rice's croquettes...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I... I see...!
Ehehe, that makes me happy...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Then I'll make a bunch next time and bring them over.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Why wait? You could make it right now, you know.
I think we have the ingredients for croquettes.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Then... I want you to eat it fresh out of the oven,
so please come with me, Onii-sama...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Then... I want you to eat it fresh out of the oven,
so please come with me, Onee-sama...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, both of you!
Trainers are strictly prohibited from entering the dorms!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Augh!? T-That's right...

A few days later, the homemade croquettes
that Rice Shower made were absolutely delicious.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Can I really be of any help?
Someone like Rice...
choice_data_list: Still, people really count on you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Do you really think so...? Hishi Ama-san,
I might end up causing you trouble, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry about it! If you're helping out, I don't mind
if you spill a bag or two of flour!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Rice...
You really found yourself a wonderful Trainer, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Not too long ago, whenever anything happened, she'd lock herself up in her room.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I was quite worried about whether you'd find a decent Trainer...
Ha ha."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! Big brother is
super gentle, and so dependable—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! Big sister is
super gentle, and so dependable—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, she's blushing, she's blushing!
Rice, keep the compliments coming!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! When it comes to your good points, Big Brother,
Rice can think of a whole bunch of them...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! When it comes to your good points, Big Sister,
Rice can think of a whole bunch of them...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother works super hard, he's really smart,
and he's so cute when he smiles..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister is a hard worker,
really smart, and so cute when she smiles...

Afterward, Rice Shower showered me with praise
for quite a while.
